stage2_context_review: Malta control and the generally low-scoring matchup remained supportive, while the recent 2-1 H2H was the preserved counterargument.
note: BTTS No won 1-0 despite a large late share drop and adverse price move. This is a direct counterexample to treating late concentration erosion as an automatic cancel rule. Late movement must be interpreted with liquidity, cross-market behavior and football context rather than with one threshold alone.
